mapper.select: select character_id, project_id, character_code, character_name, aliases_json, gender, age_range, personality_json, appearance_text, speaking_style, visual_prompt_base, status from ai_video_character where project_id = #{projectId} and character_code = #{characterCode} and del_flag = '0' limit 1 for update

select character_id, project_id, character_code, character_name, aliases_json, gender, age_range, personality_json, appearance_text, speaking_style, visual_prompt_base, status from ai_video_character where project_id = #{projectId} and del_flag = '0' and (character_code = #{characterCode} or character_name = #{characterName} or exists ( select 1 from json_table(coalesce(aliases_json, json_array()), '$[*]' columns(alias_value varchar(255) character set utf8mb4 collate utf8mb4_unicode_ci path '$')) existing_alias where lower(trim(existing_alias.alias_value)) = lower(trim(#{characterName})) ) or exists ( select 1 from json_table(cast(#{aliasesJson} as json), '$[*]' columns(alias_value varchar(255) character set utf8mb4 collate utf8mb4_unicode_ci path '$')) incoming_alias where lower(trim(incoming_alias.alias_value)) = lower(trim(character_name)) )) order by case when character_code = #{characterCode} then 0 when character_name = #{characterName} then 1 else 2 end, character_id for update

select character_id, project_id, character_code, character_name, aliases_json, gender, age_range, personality_json, appearance_text, speaking_style, visual_prompt_base, status from ai_video_character where project_id = #{projectId} and del_flag = '0' order by character_id
mapper.insert: insert into ai_video_character (project_id, character_code, character_name, aliases_json, gender, age_range, personality_json, appearance_text, speaking_style, visual_prompt_base, status, create_by, create_time) values (#{projectId}, #{characterCode}, #{characterName}, #{aliasesJson}, #{gender}, #{ageRange}, #{personalityJson}, #{appearanceText}, #{speakingStyle}, #{visualPromptBase}, #{status}, #{createBy}, now()) on duplicate key update character_id = last_insert_id(character_id)
mapper.update: update ai_video_character set aliases_json = #{aliasesJson}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where character_id = #{characterId} and del_flag = '0'
